printed_title: UPERC (Rooftop Solar PV Grid Interactive System Gross/Net Metering) Regulation, 2019 (Second Amendment)

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: (I) All Public Institutions covered under LMV-4A consumer category of the Rate Schedule except such consumers which are covered under LMV-4A(c) as provided in the Rate Schedule.
candidate_clauses.topic: Net metering extended to LMV-4A/4B, HV-1 institutions
candidate_clauses.note: Eligibility scope; potential tension with ROC 2021 Rule 11(4) (net metering for prosumers up to 500 kW) only where state regs are silent.
